concurrency: Packaging is a build-time concern; installed import and CLI execution are single-process and offline.
inputs: existing xverse_xdl API and xdl CLI
outputs: additive wheel configuration and one xverse-argus entry point
preserved xverse_xdl imports and xdl CLI
purpose: Deliver Argus as an additive xverse namespace/package wheel configuration with one frozen additive consumer entry point that preserves the xverse-xdl name, the xdl CLI, the accepted xverse_xdl imports and the accepted C++ X-COM contracts, rejects unknown major versions and defines additive unknown-field behaviour explicitly.
state: Owns the additive packaging surface only; owns no accepted xverse_xdl or C++ state and changes no existing wheel entry.

static_checks.expected: the wheel contains xverse/argus and xverse_xdl, contains no xcom C++ member, and preserves the xverse-xdl name and xdl entry point while adding xverse-argus
static_checks.rule: wheel member inspection plus a diff-scope check that the wheel contains xverse.argus and xverse_xdl but no src/xverse/xcom member, that the xverse-xdl name and xdl entry point are unchanged, and that the xverse-argus entry point is present
static_checks.tool: repository static inspection (python ast parse and diff/wheel scope check; consumed by the trusted ARGUS2-STATIC measure)

title: ARGUS2-SR-012-U unit specification - Additive packaging, installed-wheel compatibility and preserved contracts

unit_cases.expected: the module resolves inside the installed target, not the source tree
unit_cases.precondition: the built wheel installed into an isolated target with an empty PYTHONPATH outside the source tree

unit_cases.expected: the accepted plan API still resolves inside the installed target and is unchanged
unit_cases.precondition: the built wheel installed into an isolated target

unit_cases.expected: the 'xdl' entry point and the 'xverse-xdl' distribution name are unchanged
unit_cases.stimulus: inspect console entry points and distribution name

unit_cases.expected: xverse-argus = xverse.argus.cli:main is present as the one additive consumer entry point
no src/xverse/xcom C++ header or source member is packaged; only the additive Argus package enters the wheel
ARGUS2-SCHEMA-MAJOR-UNSUPPORTED with a bounded partial result
unit_cases.precondition: a run whose manifest/event schemaVersion major is not 1, read via the installed wheel

unit_cases.expected: the outside-extensions key is rejected with ARGUS2-SCHEMA-UNKNOWN-FIELD; the extensions namespace is preserved verbatim and never interpreted
unit_cases.precondition: a record with an unknown key outside extensions and a record with an unknown extensions namespace
unit_cases.stimulus: append/read both via the installed wheel

unit_cases.expected: the owned Argus tests pass against the installed wheel; no source-tree sys.path entry is injected
unit_cases.precondition: the owned test directory copied outside the source tree and run with PYTHONPATH resolving only to the installed target
unit_cases.stimulus: pytest the copied owned Argus tests

unit_cases.expected: no file under src/xverse/xcom, src/xverse_xdl, xdl, proto or an existing test is modified
unit_cases.stimulus: repository static inspection of the changed path set

unit_cases.expected: the accepted xdl CLI behaviour is unchanged by the additive packaging
unit_cases.stimulus: invoke the existing xdl version/validate behaviour
